summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for senior autocallable contingent coupon barrier notes due November 1, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Russell 2000 Index and EURO STOXX 50 Index. Notes price at $1,000 stated principal with a $25.50 quarterly contingent coupon, issued from the Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, with a pricing date of October 27, 2026 and issue date of October 30, 2026. This is routine structured note issuance, not a special situation; watch for final pricing, coupon reset, and index path dependency.
